scope: Steadier sessions, from the 1.0.0.7 test: the automatic bitrate held to what the picture needs and followed during the session (changed on the host while the stream runs), video paced below the loss-free rate, the Bazzite headset PC balanced during sessions, SteamVR 2.0 base stations on at Start and off at closing, the gaze centred per calibration, recommended settings in one step. Every package carries version 1.0.0.8; the host driver is 1.0.0.6's; no native source changed beyond the version label.
changes: launcher/stream_budget.py (new): the picture's bitrate ceiling (bits per pixel by codec x encoded pixels x frame rate) and the bitrate governor (losses, slow decoding, late uneven frames; steps of -20 %/+10 %, back-off, the decoding check)

launcher/session_link.py: the bitrate-control feature, bitrate in heartbeats, the lease starting at the session's bitrate, a host worker applying changes at most every 2 s (three tries a session); host/control.py: HostControl.set_bitrate through ALVR's session/values
launcher/link_test.py, network_test.py: wired pacing at 70 % of the loss-free rate (PACING_HEADROOM)

launcher/session_tuning.py (new): the performance balance through steamos-manager (TDP on the charger, the manual GPU clock when frames run late), only while video streams, restored at Stop or from a receipt

launcher/base_stations.py and BaseStations.ps1 (new): SteamVR 2.0 base stations over BlueZ and Windows' Bluetooth API; --base-stations in bootstrap.py and app.py; on at Start, off at closing (a separate process), buttons
launcher/gaze_provider.py: GazeCentre and gaze_quaternion; eye_tracking.py: the centre in the relay; baballonia.py: calibrations, previous_calibration, use_calibration

launcher/app.py: the ceiling and governor in host_preferences and the TIMING parser, the balance from the performance samples, the base stations at Start and closing, recommended settings, client-option, base-stations, eye-calibration, gaze-centre-reset; status and report fields
launcher/desktop.html, game_ui.py: the bitrate, balance and base-station lines, the three live switches, the buttons, centring and the previous calibration, Use recommended settings
packaging/build_windows_client.py: BaseStations.ps1 required in the Windows client's payload

tests: tests/test_vrostbridge_1008.py and page checks; earlier tests updated to the 1.0.0.8 pacing, picture ceiling and Game Mode rows; the session-lifecycle fixture stands in for BaseStations and SessionTuning
Documents, records and code comments: the maintainer's own hardware no longer named by model anywhere; the defaults are general (relative to the codec, the frame interval and each GPU's own clocks)
Version 1.0.0.8 on every package; documents and release notes

host.driver: 1.0.0.6's build, byte for byte (ALVR f5023f8e with patches 0001 to 0020)

toolchain: As 1.0.0.7: Ubuntu 24.04.5, GCC 13.3.0, CMake 3.28.3 + Ninja 1.11.1 (Linux client); clang-cl/lld-link/llvm-lib/llvm-rc 19.1.1 + xwin Windows SDK and CRT (Windows client and launchers); PyInstaller 6.22.3 / Python 3.12.3; NSIS 3.09; ReportLab (PDFs) with mermaid-cli in Chromium; Wine 9.0 with Mesa lavapipe; Node 22 (page checks); PowerShell 7.4.6 (script parse). The transport DLL and FFmpeg are 1.0.0.7's.
